case_title.quote: KILAKKATHA PARAMBATH SASI & ORS. v. STATE OF KERALA

number_of_accused.quote: The Trial Court acquitted all the seven accused.
number_of_accused.reason: Seven were charged and tried; four are appellants. The value 4 reflects only the appellants.

accused_gender.reason: Gender is not explicitly stated, though names imply male; 'Not stated' is acceptable.

accused_occupation.reason: Occupation not stated; political party membership only.

victim_gender.quote: PW-1 Shaji, who is the brother of the deceased, Sathyan
victim_gender.reason: Deceased is a brother; both victims are male.

victim_age.reason: Age not stated (Sathyan referred to as 'another youth' in the trial quote only).

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: No familial relationship; political rivals (BJP accused vs Congress workers); otherwise strangers/acquaintances not specified
accused_victim_relationship.quote: the accused belonged to the Bhartiya Janta Party whereas PW-1 and his brother were workers of the Congress Party
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment states a political rivalry relationship, so 'Not stated' is inaccurate.

offence_category.quote: convicted under Section 302 r/w Section 34 IPC

weapon.quote: assaulted PW-1 and his brother with sword, axe and knife

evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, medical, and investigative evidence are all present.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: 58 injuries thereon, most of them incised and cutting wounds, some of them of huge dimensions

trial_court_outcome.quote: The Trial Court acquitted all the seven accused.

high_court_outcome.quote: reversed the acquittal of four accused (the appellants)... acquittal of other three accused was maintained

offence_finally_established.quote: sentenced to life imprisonment under Section 302 r/w Section 34

neutral_facts.correct_value: Same summary, but the victim's brother died after being referred to Kozhikode Medical College (not clearly said 'died there'); the facts also state he died at about 4 p.m.
neutral_facts.quote: Sathyan was referred to Kozhikode Medical College where he soon died
neutral_facts.reason: Mostly accurate and does not reveal the outcome; small inconsistency over where the brother died (judgment is itself inconsistent).

attempt_completion.quote: PW-1 was grievously injured while his brother died at the hospital.

physical_harm.quote: three incised wounds were found on him as well

number_of_offences.correct_value: 5 sections charged; conviction under s.302 r/w s.34 only
number_of_offences.quote: charged for offences punishable under Sections 147, 148, 307, 324 and 302 read with Section 149
number_of_offences.reason: Roughly right, but this is a count of sections, not offences; the conviction was under s.34, not s.149.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Prosecution alleged accused waited at Babu's shop for the deceased; the SC made no finding
premeditation_planning.quote: waited at the shop of the 4th accused Babu for the deceased to reach the place in the bus
premeditation_planning.reason: The prosecution did allege waiting; the court made no express finding, but the value omits that allegation.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: PW-1 injured witness, PWs 2-4, spontaneity of FIR; medical evidence was not specifically relied on
key_evidence_accepted.quote: The prosecution story is also fully supported by the evidence of PWs 2,3 and 4.
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Medical evidence was not specifically accepted as key by the Court.

witness_credibility.quote: PW-4 who is a truly independent witness

trial_duration.quote: At about 1:45 p.m. on the 24th March; 1994

legal_representation.quote: U.R. Lalit, E.M.S. Anam, Fazlin Anam for the Appellants

investigation_status.quote: On the completion of the investigation, the accused were charged

procedural_irregularity.quote: their non-examination case would not mean that the entire prosecution story would fall through

prosecution_argument.quote: merely because PW-1 did not name all the seven accused at the first instance, was of no consequence

defence_argument.quote: the facts did not justify interference in an appeal against acquittal

legal_principle_applied.quote: the High Court can re-appraise the evidence

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Arulve/u and Anr. Vs. State represented by the Public Prosecutor and Anr.
